outcome.technical: _floor_guard.py: a new section 'what a name stands for' - _binds/_bindings, one stack pass over the copy counting every binding of every bare name file-wide at any depth (import, store, del, def, class statement, parameter, except target, global/nonlocal, match capture, type parameter) plus each star import; _resolve(name, binds) returns ('import', dotted target) only when the name is bound exactly once and that once is an import at module level with no star import anywhere, ('class', line, words) for one class statement, ('builtin', None, words) for a name bound nowhere, else (None, None, words) - words true of the whole file. SKIP_FORMS is read through _skip_form(func, binds): a row only where the head resolves to an import of the row's module; a skip-spelled call whose head does not resolve, or resolves to a relative import, is nobody's: _reason_aside blanks all its arguments and records (owner, dump, why), _parse_test carries them as tree.unresolved_skips and the bindings as tree.binds, and _python_test adds _unresolved_reason, so a changed argument reads not compared (naming the definition, the name and how the file binds it), never a changed head; a call proven another module's (_harness.skip) is no row and is compared whole. Rule 3: _base_reading follows a bare base bound once by a class statement in any position, reads an import or a builtin as another module's, declines anything else with a reason. Rule 4: _namespace_uses (one BFS walk) records every reference to globals/locals/vars, called or not, that is not read in place (subscript load, compare, iteration, a _READING_METHODS call) or handed directly by position or keyword to a callee _proven_callee proves (an import, or a builtin other than exec/eval - builtins_write.py run over every callable of builtins: only exec and eval write into a handed dict). Tables now: _COMPUTED = the copy's own namespace used other than to read it in place; a setattr call; an exec or eval call; a star import. _CLASS_COMPUTED = a class decorator; a metaclass; a base class of the copy running code for each subclass; a base class of the copy binding names by computation; a base class the reading cannot follow. Removed as special cases of not proven: _imported, _spelling, _reason_of, _marks_only, _namespace_store, _namespace_written, _namespace_handed, _file_callee, _type_call, _rebound_base, _NAMESPACE_WRITES, the per-row example constants and find_moves' bindings parameter (rows: the namespace store/write/handed-to-a-file-callee rows, the type() row, the base-bound-twice row). Payload shape and SET_ASIDE unchanged. tests/test__floor_guard.py: removed fx10/fx11 (per-row examples run with and without the row) and the old fx12; new fm83 (9 deny inputs read not compared with the word of what was not proven), fm84 (two-place import, rebound module, star import: reason/condition change is never a finding), fm85 (a skip-spelled call of another module's import is an ordinary call: a finding), fa60 (allow twins read clean), fx13 (generated pairs over GEN_DIMENSIONS, 8 dimensions; the case prints its pair count; each copy executed in-process as a module of a generated package, tests run by calling them and by unittest.TestResult; the oracle _gen_failing imports and calls nothing of the floor guard), fx14 (the README passage and the build guide paragraph each name every BINDINGS row; the not-read list stands in the guide's paragraph alone). Changed: fa58 (one import of unittest, since a second binds it twice), fm78 (the type() input removed: running both copies loses nothing), fx4's invariant (an edited unresolved skip expects not compared). Suite: 169/169, about 12 s against 11.3 s before (round one; rounds two and three in the reply). Mutation probe (scratchpad sg1.56/mutations.py, 22 rows on copies: rules 1-4 off, rule 2 over-firing, MA MB MC MD MI ME MF MM re-anchored, the oracle given the guard's answer, three allow rows, three document rows): every row caught. Commit measurement over 1055 task commits against sg1.50's: no verdict moved; 7 commits gain a not-compared clause on files already not compared (a local dict named mark, a file's own def skip). Sweeps n1_noise, n2_shapes, n2_classes, u1_unsafe, n3_skipdeco: no flip.
